content.text:
All 18 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary:

**Deviations / missing (redlines proposed):**
- **LOL-CAP** — cap's only carve-out cross-references the Independent Contractor clause, so confidentiality, indemnity and misconduct all sit inside a "fees paid" per-SOW cap. Reset to greater of 12 months' fees / USD 1M with Excluded Claims.
- **INDEMN** (missing) — Section 7's heading promises indemnification but no indemnity exists anywhere; inserted Contractor indemnity.
- **T4C** — convenience termination only available when no SOW is open, and Contractor holds a 15-day right; added a 30-day Company right, moved Contractor to 90 days.
- **GOVLAW** — Arizona law; moved to New York law and venue.
- **ASSIGN** — blanket consent bar with no affiliate/M&A carve-out; added carve-out and no change-of-control right.
- **LICENSE** — perpetual grant omits affiliates/contractors, "irrevocable" and successor transfer.
- **WARRANTY** — no conformance warranty, period or remedy behind a full implied-warranty disclaimer; inserted 90-day warranty and remedy.
- **INSURANCE** — no cyber cover for a vendor handling our records; added USD 2M.
- **TRANSITION** (missing) — no data return, export or deletion on exit; inserted exit paragraph.

**Compliant (no redline):** NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY, MFN, NOSOLICIT (at fallback; general-advertising carve-out noted), RENEWAL (no auto-renewal), IP, AUDIT, LD, MINCOMMIT.
